mechanism: Bupropion inhibits norepinephrine reuptake while guanfacine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist, creating opposing sympathomimetic and sympatholytic effects with potential for blood pressure dysregulation and CNS effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider alternative antidepressant or antihypertensive if combination is necessary; educate patient on orthostatic symptoms.
